name: Fon Terum
source: The second in command of the current demon realm.  She is directly in the service of Toria and in charge when Toria isn't present in the demon realm.  She is known for her ruthlessness and absolute devotion to the good of the demon race and Toria in particular.  [spoiler]Due to events in the past, she has a deep hatred for the dragon half of her bloodline and Ururu in particular.  [/spoiler]
